context: Use a w0 reproduction against the current factory and registry, choose the smallest contract-preserving correction, align schema/validation/factory/docs, and prove local, remote, and rejected Docker behavior. Treat Docker packaging as deployment infrastructure unless an explicit endpoint, lifecycle, and trust contract is approved.
description: Adversarial review found that the MCP schema accepts deployment=\"docker\", while the Velox registry and adapter implement only local and remote. The adapter treats every non-local value as remote and therefore turns docker into an implicit remote endpoint instead of a Docker deployment. Revalidate the current registry, adapter, CLI, and docs contract, then make the MCP choice fail closed or implement a separately specified Docker mode without changing the meaning of local/remote.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not add a Docker branch without a documented lifecycle, endpoint, isolation, and cleanup contract
anti_patterns.instead: Treat Docker as packaging infrastructure unless a separate contract is approved
anti_patterns.why: A partial Docker mode would create ambiguous ownership and security behavior

anti_patterns.dont: Do not leave any non-local string implicitly mapped to remote
anti_patterns.instead: Enumerate supported values and reject unknown values before factory construction
anti_patterns.why: Unknown deployment values can redirect execution to an unintended endpoint

anti_patterns.dont: Do not prove this only with schema serialization
anti_patterns.instead: Assert the adapter deployment and endpoint selected by the factory
anti_patterns.why: Serialization can pass while the factory selects the wrong deployment

preserves.behavior: Existing local and remote Velox semantics and endpoint validation remain explicit.
MCP cannot create, discover, or contact an arbitrary Docker or remote endpoint from an option value.
No live Velox service, Docker daemon, or user credential is used by validation tests.

prior_art.concept: authoritative Velox deployment choices are local and remote
adapter maps non-local deployment to remote

work_units.evidence: Schema half already closed by PR #1486, which changed velox deployment choices from ('local','docker') to ('local','remote'); validate_platform_options('velox',{'deployment':'docker'}) already raises. NOT re-implemented. Remaining defect confirmed at velox.py:116-123: self.deployment = config.get('deployment') or config.get('deployment_mode') or 'local', then EVERY subsequent branch is a bare 'if self.deployment == "local": ... else: <remote>'. So any unknown string ('docker', a typo, a future value) silently routes to the Spark-Connect remote path with endpoint defaulting to sc://localhost:50051. Authoritative supported set is local/remote per the module docstring (velox.py:21) and the two-mode design note (velox.py:82). Docker is packaging infrastructure (docker/ + deploy/ trees, both do_not_modify) with no lifecycle, endpoint, isolation, or cleanup contract, so it stays rejected rather than partially implemented.
work_units.summary: Reproduce the docker-to-remote misrouting and confirm the authoritative supported deployment set.

work_units.evidence: w1: SUPPORTED_VELOX_DEPLOYMENTS=frozenset({'local','remote'}) + VeloxAdapter._validate_deployment() called from __init__ before the endpoint/caching branches; unknown values now raise ValueError instead of falling through to the Spark-Connect remote path. Docker rejected with a message pointing at the real workflow (deployment='local' inside the container) rather than partially implemented -- no Docker lifecycle/endpoint/isolation/cleanup contract exists and docker/ + deploy/ are do_not_modify. w2: tests/unit/platforms/test_velox_adapter.py TestDeploymentContractIsEnumerated (docker rejected, rejection message names packaging infrastructure, 6 unknown values incl. a raw sc:// endpoint rejected, 4 accepted/normalized, adapter-vs-MCP-allowlist parity) plus constructor tests for BOTH spellings (deployment and deployment_mode alias) and a test that local/remote still select their own endpoints and caching flags. w3: docs/reference/mcp.md records the enumerated contract and why docker is rejected. Ladder rung1 8235 passed, rung2 684 passed, rung3 ruff clean. Negative control: reverting only velox.py fails 15. No live Velox service, Docker daemon, or credential is used.
